scenario: Comments per LGRA.15.9 — `#` to end-of-line; any count of leading `#` is valid. A top-level comment, a `##` comment after a slot and a trailing comment after an action are accepted, and the program compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES.
rules_ds:
# top-level comment
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key  ## inline doc-style

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log info "x"  # trailing
